name: Tiwanaku: Spiritual and Political Centre of the Tiwanaku Culture
description: Tiwanaku is an ancient ceremonial and political capital in western Bolivia, near Lake Titicaca and about 70 kilometres from La Paz. At its peak between 500 and 900 AD, it ruled a vast stretch of the southern Andes and may have housed 10,000 to 20,000 people. Today you can wander about four square kilometres of ruins, with monumental structures and huge megalithic stone blocks.
